The '''Alsakan Mosaics''' were a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]]-scale mosaic that was at one point located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]]. During the [[14,450 BBY]] conflict known as the [[Cleansing of Rucapar]], the centerpiece of the artwork was destroyed, although the Alsakan Mosaics were subsequently included by the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Vicendi]] in the list known as the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]] in [[10,000 BBY]].

==Description==
The Alsakan Mosaics were a spectacular artwork at one point located on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]]. Made out of<ref name="TEA" /> gleaming<ref name="Jewel">''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]''</ref> tiles, the mosaic featured a centerpiece located in the central square of the old [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rucapar]]. From there, five lanes of tile radiated outward and stretched to the summits of five equidistant [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:WondersOfTheGalaxy-TheJewelOfYavin.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A replica of the Alsakan Mosaics was displayed as part of the exhibit "Wonders of the Galaxy" (pictured) in the Figg & Associates Art Museum.]]
The centerpiece of the Alsakan Mosaics was destroyed<ref name="TEA" /> during the [[14,450 BBY]] confrontation known as the [[Cleansing of Rucapar]].<ref name="Date" /> The event was a part of the [[Third Alsakan Conflict]], the third of a fourteen-[[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-long [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|series]] of wars over [[Politics/Legends|political]] control of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] between Alsakan, the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and their respective allies.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

After the destruction of the mosaic's centerpiece, only traces of the artwork remained, although it was immortalized as one of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]]&mdash;a list of spectacular, antique artificial objects that the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Vicendi]] compiled in [[10,000 BBY]] for the publication ''[[Arturum Galactinum]]''.<ref name="TEA" /> At some point between [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Jewel dates">{{JewelofYavindate}}</ref> a section of the Alsakan Mosaics was also represented by a replica that covered the floor at "[[Wonders of the Galaxy (exhibit)|Wonders of the Galaxy]]," an exhibit of the [[Figg & Associates Art Museum]] in the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] settlement of<ref name="Jewel" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The Alsakan Mosaics. This references the Core World of Alsakan, and is another wonder that has been largely destroyed in the modern era.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Blog">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2009/08/endnotes-for-star-wars-essential-atlas_24.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 2 of 5)}}</ref>}}
The Alsakan Mosaics were introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" /> Wallace noted in his personal blog that he particularly enjoyed creating names for those of the Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy that were original to the book, which included the mosaic.<ref name="Blog" /> The Alsakan Mosaics made their first appearance in a replica form in ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'', a [[2014]] adventure supplement for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]] system.<ref name="Jewel" />
